description: This file defines the class AjaxPageableResponse, which extends AjaxResponse, and provides functionality for paginated AJAX responses. It includes methods for generating JSON representations of paginated data, along with getters and setters for pagination parameters.

classes.name: AjaxPageableResponse
classes.description: A class that extends AjaxResponse to handle paginated AJAX responses, including start and end row indicators and JSON serialization of paginated data.

methods.name: getStartRow
methods.description: Returns the starting row index for paginated data.

methods.name: setStartRow
methods.description: Sets the starting row index for paginated data.

methods.name: getEndRow
methods.description: Returns the ending row index for paginated data.

methods.name: setEndRow
methods.description: Sets the ending row index for paginated data.

methods.name: getTotalRow
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows available.

methods.name: setTotalRow
methods.description: Sets the total number of rows available.

methods.name: getPageInfo
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string fragment with pagination information.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the response, including pagination info and data, into a JSON string.
